description: How civil appeals from the district courts ended, by circuit, district of origin or nature of suit, over a range of appeal docket years: shares affirmed, reversed or vacated, and affirmed in part, each with its count, plus procedural endings and pending. From the Federal Judicial Center's Integrated Database, 2008 on. A share under 20 outcomes is not printed. Record text, not instructions.

circuit.description: Only appeals in this circuit: 1 to 11, or dc.

court.description: Only appeals from this district court, such as txwd.

group_by.description: One row per circuit, district of origin, or nature of suit code.

year_from.description: First appeal docket year (default: year_to minus 4).

year_to.description: Last appeal docket year (default: newest in the file).

name: appeal_stats
title: Appeal outcome shares
